spans.s:
The affix टच् comes optionally after an अव्ययीभाव समास ending in a letter of झय्class (a mute letter).

Terms: टच्

The व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a mute consonant.

Terms: मतुप्

In the room of ह after (a sonant Mute) there is optionally a letter homogenous with the prior.
